## Summary

Currently researching adversarial attacks on multi-agentic AI systems in cybersecurity workflows at Georgia Tech. Contributed to the mainnet launch of Shardeum — the world's first sharded autoscaling EVM-compatible L1 blockchain (80M+ transactions, 150K+ validators).

## Experience

### Georgia Institute of Technology — Researcher, AI Security (Apr 2026 – Present)
- Investigating adversarial attacks on multi-agentic AI systems in cybersecurity workflows, targeting SOC pipelines with agentic orchestration and generative AI threat surfaces.
- Building evaluation pipelines to assess robustness of AI-driven SOC workflows against prompt injection, tool misuse, and inter-agent manipulation.

### Liberdus — Software Engineer, Distributed Systems (Jan 2026 – Present)
- Built the Liberdus BSC bridge and cross-chain payment platform; reduced transaction time to finality by 85%.
- Cut historical data sync latency by 63%; reduced heap memory usage by 50% through RPC response caching.
- Improved transaction latency by 38%; built horizontally scalable blockchain indexing microservice.
- Implemented cryptographic libraries in Rust for identity verification and threshold signatures; led DevSecOps as primary security maintainer.
- https://liberdus.com

### Shardeum — Senior Software Engineer (Aug 2022 – Jan 2026)
- Built horizontally scalable monitoring handling 10,000+ req/sec with shared global state and real-time dashboards.
- Reduced communication latency by 34% (82 ms → 54 ms); boosted RPC throughput 60% with WebSocket distribution.
- Achieved 14× speedup on ECDSA verification (10 ms → 700 μs); reduced cryptographic latency 29% via libsodium migration.
- Discovered and fixed critical bugs in Proof of Quorum consensus; contributed to mainnet launch (80M+ transactions, 150K+ validators).
- https://shardeum.org

### BITS Pilani Hyderabad — Researcher, HCI & Applied AI (Aug 2021 – Jul 2022)

## Open source

### Shardeum (Mainnet L1)
Autoscaling EVM blockchain with dynamic state sharding. ~$24M raised (Jane Street, Spartan Group, CoinGecko Ventures). Mainnet live since 2025 — scaled to 80M+ transactions and 150K+ validators during tenure.
- Shardeum Core: https://github.com/shardeum/core — Shardus Core distributed ledger engine (consensus, state management, validator coordination)
- Shardeum Archiver: https://github.com/shardeum/archiver — Archiver node storing complete cycle chain and historical state data
- Shardeum: https://github.com/shardeum/shardeum — EVM-compatible autoscaling L1 node software
- JSON-RPC Server: https://github.com/shardeum/json-rpc-server — JSON-RPC gateway; WebSocket distribution boosted throughput 60%
- lib-net: https://github.com/shardeum/lib-net — High-performance TCP library for JSON messaging; reduced latency 34% (82 ms → 54 ms)
- Blockscout: https://github.com/shardeum/blockscout — Shardeum fork of Blockscout block explorer

### Farcaster (Protocol · Dev infra)
Decentralized social protocol for onchain identity and feeds. $180M raised from Paradigm and a16z (~$1B valuation). ~250K monthly active users and 100K+ funded wallets; acquired by Neynar in 2026 with a developer-first pivot.
- Farcaster Snapchain: https://github.com/farcasterxyz/snapchain — Enhanced event filtering and querying APIs with timestamp and block-based filters

### Liberdus (Mainnet · Messaging)
Quantum-secure decentralized messaging and payments on Shardus. Community-funded model with no VC or pre-mine (210M LIB fixed supply). Cross-chain bridge and TSS signing infrastructure live.
- Liberdus TSS Signer: https://github.com/Liberdus/tss-signer — Multi-network threshold signature signer with configurable routing, gas estimation, and Ed25519 signing in Rust
